rulesAndMechanisms: Rice uses real source-instance public piles, true Ending draw/HE storage, one incoming/outgoing beneficiary option per damage point, exact public-rice judgment replacement and recovery after the last actual rice movement.

Courtesy and faction distance changes are permanent directed numeric adjustments; issued benefits survive source removal, use current live-faction count after paid children, and coexist with fixed-distance priority.

Fengzi performs one extra complete effect round under the same actual Use and ActionId with one hand cost, one native acceptance and completion; second responses/nullification are actual new native windows.

Stacked Wine uses numeric damage bonus while preserving the original boolean 0/1 meaning. Optional public AlcoholDamageBonus is emitted only for stacked values; actual WPF bound badges show the public bonus and clear normally.

Rank guessing resets the current actual Draw plan, preserves later same-window independent draw adjustments, reveals real top entities, uses strict comparisons including ties, supports optional continuation after a correct guess, and gains all revealed entities including failed comparison.

Death granting preserves the dead owner's optional recipient choice, then requires the chosen recipient to select exactly Fengzi or Jizhan. Real recipient-owned selection, permanent grants, owner decline and cold recovery are verified.
